name: ADQ (Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Company)
via: Owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi; its assets and investments were consolidated under L'IMAD Holding by a resolution of the Supreme Council for Financial and Economic Affairs in January 2026 (claim etihad-limad-2026)
note: ADQ press release: 'The Supreme Council for Financial and Economic Affairs has transferred full ownership of Etihad Aviation Group (EAG) to ADQ, an Abu Dhabi-based investment and holding company.' The ADQ mark is on the sleeves of the 2026 UAE Team Emirates XRG jersey, launched in December 2025, before the consolidation into L'IMAD.
